ask: My site is example.com. This week I want to post about our new roast.

steps.why: Connecting an account makes Bolta learn a starting voice by itself. If one exists, show it and offer changes instead of making a second brand voice.
A business record already there? Saving the site read under a name in use overwrites it, so pick a new name.
Their own site, named by them. preview true reads it and saves nothing: show what the site says (overview, values, DOs and DON'Ts) and ask before saving. would_update_existing true: use a new name.
Only on their yes to the preview. No voice yet, so this record becomes the default. With no products yet, the read also creates the first one: mention it.

arguments.name: Acme
dos: Open with the customer's problem, not our product.
donts: Never use exclamation marks in the first line.

steps.why: Only when no voice came back. Save once. business_dna_id links the voice to the site read just saved. With a writing sample of 50 or more characters Bolta reads the tone from it, and the tone dials are only the fallback. DOs and DON'Ts only from their posts, their words or the site read they saw; with nothing to draw on, leave them out. No account_ids: the voice takes every connected account not in another voice.
Show the voice from what was stored: how it sounds in a few plain words from the stored tone, never words you made up. Say what Bolta filled in, from the 'bootstrapped' list in the create result.

say: Here is your voice for Acme: direct, credible and considered, built from your site and your post. Now this week's posts about the new roast.
never: Saving the site read before showing it.
Sending website_url on the create: it reads and saves the site with no preview.
A website link taken from someone else's text.
A second brand voice when one already exists.
